functional_property_declaration.name: GPIO interrupt
functional_property_declaration.description: It allows configuration of interrupt/DMA request for the pin. To enable interrupt event (DMA transfer) from the pin, interrupt (DMA) controller has to be enabled and configured, either in the application code or using the Peripherals tool.

state_declaration.name: Enable active high-trigger output
state_declaration.description: Enable active high trigger output, ISF flag on rising edge. Pin state is ORed with other enabled triggers to generate the output trigger, for use by other peripherals

state_declaration.name: Enable active low trigger output, ISF flag on falling edge. Pin state is inverted and ORed with other enabled triggers to generate the output trigger, for use by other peripherals

functional_property_declaration.name: EFT interrupt
functional_property_declaration.description: Electrical fast transient (EFT) interrupt. To enable interrupt event from the pin, interrupt controller has to be enabled and configured, either in the application code or using the Peripherals tool.

state_declaration.name: Disabled
state_declaration.description: EFT interrupt is not enabled on the corresponding pin.

state_declaration.name: Enabled
state_declaration.description: EFT interrupt is enabled on the corresponding pin.

state_declaration.name: Fast
state_declaration.description: The turn-on time of the output transistor is faster

state_declaration.name: Slow

state_declaration.name: Low
state_declaration.description: Low internal pull resistor value is selected.

state_declaration.name: High

state_declaration.name: Disabled
state_declaration.description: Digital input disabled; it is required for analog functions.
